about: Every external input of the Windows build, pinned by SHA-256 (files) or commit (git). The build downloads and checks them before compiling and refuses anything not listed here. Entries without a sha256 are filled by the 'Lock inputs' workflow (.github/workflows/lock-inputs.yml), reviewed, then committed. Keys are the URLs the builder requests; 'fetch' is the immutable URL actually downloaded when the requested one is a moving 'latest' link.
